intro_html: The effective date drives everything in a Texas contract — option period, earnest money, financing, closing. Dossie computes all of it the moment a contract is scanned, including the weekend/Legal Holiday rollover rules agents usually track by hand.

steps.p: Option period expiration, earnest money due date, financing deadline, and closing date — calculated from the effective date the second the contract is scanned. No manual counting.
Wire fraud advisory and IABS disclosure reminders show up on the dossier without anyone having to remember to add them.
Every deadline stays visible on the dossier and the Morning Brief until it's resolved — nothing quietly falls off a whiteboard.

callout: If a deadline lands on a weekend or a Legal Holiday, Dossie rolls it forward the same way the contract does — automatically, every time.
cta_sub: Dossie tracks every TREC deadline for every active deal — plus follow-ups, document QA, and contract scanning. Built for Texas agents.

faq.q: How does Dossie calculate TREC deadlines?
faq.a: From the contract's effective date, applying the same day-counting and weekend/Legal Holiday rollover rules as the TREC forms themselves — computed automatically once the contract is scanned.

faq.q: Does Dossie remind me about wire fraud and IABS disclosures?
faq.a: Yes — those warnings are surfaced on the dossier automatically alongside the computed deadlines, not as a separate manual step.
